encoder.H_definition: sum_v e_v^T H_unit e_v; no factor0.5
encoder.H_geometry_repetition_scope: model-derived per-unit H is fixed for the frozen model and repeated across requests; observation counts are not independent learned matrices
encoder.L2_definition: unweighted sum of squared source-minus-actualHalf decoder values over covered V20 only
encoder.changed_alpha_count_semantics: changed_alpha_bits in frozen factory counts unequal int16 Half elements including mode signbit; not bit-popcount or magnitude-only changes
encoder.changed_word_count_semantics: changed base/sign words are unequal packed int32 words, distinct from joint raw base-bit count
encoder.half_H_definition: exactly0.5 times the separately reported H quadratic; same baselines
encoder.joint_final_baseline: full-H guarded joint-final (original point plus H-gated MSE proposal and2 four-level base/sign sweeps), not unconditional MSE-JointV-final
encoder.mode_fraction_denominator: sum over requests of20*actual_visual_token_count; not all112 V units
encoder.operation_count_semantics: channel visits and four-level values are derived from actual recorded2 sweeps, D128, N and2 predictors; not measured GPU kernel counts or throughput
encoder.search_update_count_semantics: coordinate updates along evaluated search paths; P0/P1 diagnostics include the predictor not finally deployed
encoder.spatial_baseline: the respective final frozen base/current fields; H-joint-final for JointSpatialWO, original R7 for SpatialWO
